facts.text: The clone's linear units are all with respect to 1 mm: mm = 1, um = 1e-3 and inches = 25.4
multiaxis_linear_slides is the module's multiaxis linear-slide class
The class takes a connection and a devices mapping and gives zaber_multidevice units_per_step = mm_per_rev / steps_per_rev with move_units = the units argument
The clone's multiaxis example names the axes x, y and z on device numbers 1, 2 and 3
Commands are looked up by name in the base_commands and move_commands tables: home is 1, return_current_position is 60, absolute is 20 and stop is 23
The class exposes commands dynamically through __getattr__: a base command name calls enqueue_base_command, move_<name> calls move() and get_<setting> calls get()
get_current_position returns each device's current position divided by its microsteps_per_unit
A blocking move converts each axis position to microsteps with microsteps_per_unit and calls that device's move() with blocking=True
emergency_stop broadcasts the stop command to every device immediately
The emergency branch of do_now sends (0, command, data) through the connection without waiting for a reply
A command is a (device_id, command, data) frame written through serial_connection.send_command
The clone's dummy simulator implements get_current_position and move_absolute but no home or emergency_stop, so it cannot serve this driver's stop path
